# Xray-core

The opt-in Xray test channel uses the Xray-core binary as a separate process.

- Source: https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core
- Version used by `scripts/fetch-xray.sh`: `v26.9.9`
- Fetch: `scripts/fetch-xray.sh`

The binary is not included in the repository. The disposable test package is
separate from the existing Prod and Nightly release artifacts.
